subject.title: Fix dashboard chat run recovery across reconnects

question: Should maintainers repair this stale branch, ask the contributor to rebase and prove it, or preserve the useful idea in a replacement PR against current main?
rationale: The branch contains useful work for an open linked bug, but current main has moved the protocol and restart/session lifecycle surfaces enough that a merge-safe path needs owner judgment.

options.title: Rebase And Reshape
options.body: Update the branch to current main's packages/gateway-protocol and restart/session lifecycle contracts, then require real Dashboard proof before merge.

options.title: Use As Replacement Source
options.body: Open or adopt a narrower maintainer-owned replacement if rebasing would carry too much stale runtime shape while preserving contributor attribution.

options.title: Keep Paused
options.body: Leave the PR open but unmergeable until the contributor supplies proof and maintainers decide whether to keep this branch as the fix path.

recommendation.title: Rebase And Reshape
recommendation.body: Update the branch to current main's packages/gateway-protocol and restart/session lifecycle contracts, then require real Dashboard proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest routing candidate from the sampled Gateway/UI history and can choose whether this stale branch should be rebased, replaced, or paused.
